column1: In a place with several floors, the points of interest list and the sonar leave out everything on the other floors. The stairs between floors stay.
column2: 在有多個樓層的地方，興趣點列表和聲納會略去其他樓層的所有內容。樓層之間的樓梯保留。

column1: Stairs you walk to another floor of the same place. Four wooden knocks climbing like rungs, from the middle of the stairway.
column2: 步行前往同一地點其他樓層的樓梯。四下像梯級一樣逐級升高的敲木聲，從樓梯正中傳來。
